labs.title: AWS Credential Evidence Review
labs.description: Review IAM credential-report CSV, distinguish unknown usage from inactivity, and turn findings into owned remediation decisions.

labs.title: AWS Deployment Role Boundaries
labs.description: Test PassRole scope, destination-service conditions, Lambda deployment access, and execution-role trust as distinct review boundaries.

labs.title: Private S3 Terraform Plan Review
labs.description: Check a real Terraform plan for bucket-bound public-access controls, ownership, encryption, versioning, and the transport-policy contract.

labs.title: AWS CloudTrail Evidence Triage
labs.description: Normalize CLI and trail exports, separate failed requests from outcomes, deduplicate events, and preserve session-level investigation evidence.

labs.title: Agentic Cloud Security Essentials
labs.description: Run tool-policy, tenant, schema, budget, approval-binding, expiry, and replay tests; connect the results to current MCP authorization guidance.

labs.title: Zero-Trust Architecture
labs.description: Establish real local mTLS, authorize certificate URI identities, and reject missing certificates, spoofed headers, and unauthorized routes.

labs.title: Threat Modeling Practical Guide
labs.description: Turn RAG tenant boundaries, document permissions, cache isolation, and deletion scenarios into an owned threat register and regression tests.

labs.title: Security Engineering Fundamentals
labs.description: Verify real local signatures, artifact digests, approved builders, and source revisions; distinguish SBOMs and provenance from deployment permission.

labs.title: NMAP Practical Auditing Labs
labs.description: Run a bounded Nmap audit against an owned loopback listener, compare before/after port states, and separate exposure from vulnerability evidence.

labs.title: Ethical Hacker Practical Lab
labs.description: Catch privileged containers, host access, ambient tokens, mutable images, and unsafe init containers in local policy regressions before deployment.
